title: Koszul completion under a scalar-preserving completed coefficient isomorphism
statement: Let T,d be as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let beta identify the completed ring on the fixed small Cech site with the constant completed ring, preserving all scalars from A. Let F be a derived functor naturally isomorphic to the fixed Cech derived equivalence followed by restriction along beta inverse. For every finite list a generating the adic ideal and every actual completed-coefficient complex C, there is an isomorphism from F of the localized intrinsic Koszul fiber of C to constant quotient completion of F(Q(C)), carrying the specified Koszul-fiber unit to the constant quotient-completion unit.

source.place: current order 1316, Koszul-to-quotient comparison, including its unit equation

proof.text: The kernel of the first constant quotient projection is generated sectionwise by the images of a. Pull this kernel along beta. The scalar hypothesis identifies its generating global sections with the chosen completed Cech scalars. These generators induce epimorphisms from finite free module sheaves on every slice.

Restriction along the ring isomorphism is an exact equivalence, and it preserves and reflects local derived completeness for the transported ideal. Transport the reflection Hom bijections along this equivalence. Uniqueness of reflecting arrows gives the unit-preserving isomorphism between the ringed Koszul reflector and constant quotient completion.
The completed fiber/strict-limit comparison identifies the localized published Koszul fiber and its unit with the ringed reflector. Compose these two unit-preserving isomorphisms.
Finally conjugate by the supplied natural isomorphism of derived functors. Naturality of that isomorphism and of the constant completion unit gives the required unit equation.

proof_origin.place: Formal comparison and unit-normalization details of the recorded Koszul/quotient reconstruction; proved from the existing universal and reflector interfaces.

mathlib_searches.query: For sheaves of modules the unit of derived completion is the strict quotient cone followed by the universal derived inverse limit comparison; scalar preserving coefficient equivalences preserve Koszul completion and quotient towers
mathlib_searches.results: AdicCompletion.module; AdicCompletion; SheafOfModules.hasLimit; no matching sheaf-derived completion statement
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match. Ordinary completion and sheaf limits do not identify the specified derived units.

mathlib_searches.query: Equivalence of coefficient module categories preserves strict quotient towers and their derived completion units
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match for the sheaf coefficient presentation or its derived unit.
Useful universal comparison API, but no concrete completed-sheaf unit comparison.

mathlib_searches.results: No sheaf completion-unit theorem in Mathlib. KanExtension.Basic supplies LeftExtension.isUniversalPrecompEquiv and RightExtension.isUniversalPrecompEquiv; Derived.LeftDerived/RightDerived supply uniqueness; Limits.Preserves.Limits supplies preservesLimitNatIso.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The generic Kan-extension APIs and preservation-of-limit comparisons are reused; the stated concrete compatibility results are absent.

theorem completed_koszul_constant_transport
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (β : completedCechRing T d ≅
      ConstantCompletion.coefficients (completedCechTopology T) A d.ideal true)
    (hβ : ∀ (U : (completedCechSite T)ᵒᵖ) (x : A),
      β.hom.hom.app U ((completedCechScalar T d x).val U) =
        (ConstantCompletion.algebraSection
          (ConstantCompletion.coefficientMap (completedCechTopology T) A d.ideal) x).val U)
    (F : d.derived T ⥤ ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.coefficients (completedCechTopology T) A d.ideal true))
    (δ : F ≅ (completedCechDerivedEquiv T d).functor ⋙ ConstantCompletion.dres β.inv)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (C : CochainComplex (reductionModules T (d.completedRing T)) ℤ) :
    letI := reductionModulesHasDerivedCategory T (d.completedRing T)
    ∃ e : F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (intrinsicCompletionComplex T d r a C)) ≅
        (ConstantCompletion.completion (completedCechTopology T) A d.ideal true).obj
          (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
      F.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit T d r a C)) ≫ e.hom =
        (ConstantCompletion.completionUnit (completedCechTopology T) A d.ideal true).app
          (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))
